title: NORTHEAST as directional/route hint
hypothesis_summary: The NORTHEAST crib at indices 25-33 (disclosed plaintext) is a directional word; in hand-cipher conventions a directional word can hint at a diagonal-route reading. This pack tests whether NORTHEAST functions as both a substitution keyword AND signals a route_diagonal layer, alongside the canonical width-only diagonal alias added in LESSON-021.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: Disclosed plaintext span NORTHEAST at indices 25-33 (Sanborn confirmation 2014).

composition_templates.rationale: Directional crib word + diagonal route — NORTHEAST may be a hand-cipher directional hint coupled to a Vigenere layer.

constraints: Width pool restricted to len(NORTHEAST)=9 and 10 only.
caveats: Inferring a route layer from a directional word is speculative. Confidence scores reflect this.
Width=9 is len(NORTHEAST); width=10 is included as a near-neighbour given the K4 grid context.
